theme: 3 terms on scrolling: the view that scrolls, the full size of what is inside, and how far it has moved

terms.definition: A view that lets the user drag to see content that is bigger than the screen.
terms.example: Put the long form inside a Scroll View, so it works on small phones.

terms.definition: The full width and height of everything inside a scroll view, including the part you can't see.
terms.example: It won't scroll because the Content Size is still zero.

terms.definition: The point that shows how far a scroll view has moved from its starting position.
terms.example: Check the Content Offset to see if the user reached the bottom.

video.title: Scroll View, Content Size & Content Offset | Day 96
video.description:
Learn to explain why a long screen will not scroll: Scroll View, Content Size & Content Offset, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Scroll View - A view that lets the user drag to see content that is bigger than the screen.
Content Size - The full width and height of everything inside a scroll view, including the part you can't see.
Content Offset - The point that shows how far a scroll view has moved from its starting position.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.hook: Your long screen will not scroll. Can you explain why in English?

dialogue.title: Why won't the form scroll?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my long form won't scroll in the Scroll View.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I never set `contentSize`. It's `.zero` right now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the Scroll View thinks there is nothing to scroll. Set it to the height of the form.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Done. It scrolls now, but it opens in the middle.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Check the Content Offset. Maybe you restore an old one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, I saved the Content Offset when the screen closed.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Reset it to `.zero`, or clamp it to the new Content Size.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'll clamp it. Otherwise it jumps past the end.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thanks! Now it starts at the top.

dialogue.code:
let scrollView = UIScrollView()
scrollView.addSubview(form)
scrollView.contentSize = .zero
scrollView.contentOffset = .zero
